text: Based on the output from the NASA FIRMS dataset, there have been no fire detections intersecting with the asset (ASSET-F08) in the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026. The asset was fully covered by all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) during this time. Therefore, the asset has not been affected by fire recently.
